# steps

**In one sentence:** one subfolder per pipeline stage — the code that actually does the
work on your images (import, upscale, score, dedupe, caption, check, export).

## Why it exists
A LoRA dataset is prepared in a fixed series of stages. Each stage lives in its own
package with a `*Step` class, so one stage can be changed, tested or skipped without
touching the others. The orchestration (which steps run, in what order, with which
config) lives elsewhere — in `prepare_lora_kit/pipeline/` and `prepare_lora_kit/invoke/`.

## What's inside
Listed in the order the pipeline runs them (`order=` in `pipeline/configuration.py`):

| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `import_step/` | 0 · `ImportStep`: copies source images into the working dataset (keeping subfolders) so later steps never touch originals. |
| `upscale/` | 1 · `UpscaleStep`: upscales small images (SeedVR2 or Lanczos), cleans JPEGs into PNGs, rejects results that look invented. |
| `quality_gate/` | 2 · `QualityGateStep`: scores each image (size, blur, noise, JPEG damage, watermark) and decides keep / reject / flag, automatically or via a review gallery. |
| `curate/` | 3 · `CurateStep`: drops near-duplicates (perceptual hashes) and plots a "coverage" scatter from image embeddings. |
| `caption_bbox/` | 4 · `CaptionBboxStep`: writes a `.txt` caption per image with a vision-language model, optionally guided by boxes you draw. |
| `caption_verifier/` | 5 · `CaptionVerifierStep`: renders an image from each caption so you can mark it correct / generic / wrong and edit it. |
| `vae_gate/` | 6 · `VaeGateStep`: round-trips images through the VAE, flags ones that lose too much fine detail, lets you keep or drop them. |
| `audit/` | 7 · `AuditStep`: read-only checks — missing image/caption pairs, corrupt files, caption length, minimum resolution. |
| `bucket_pools_check/` | 8 · `BucketPoolsCheckStep`: dry run of the trainer's aspect-ratio buckets; flags thin buckets and suggests crops. |
| `export_step/` | 9 · `ExportStep`: copies new or changed image + caption pairs to a target folder after you confirm; never deletes. |
| `context.py` | `StepRunContext` — the per-run values a step needs (output dir, report path, interaction provider, enabled substeps, cancel check). |

## How it works
- A run is started by the CLI or the UI; `prepare_lora_kit/invoke/<name>_step.py` builds
  a `StepRunContext` and calls the step with its config dataclass from
  `pipeline/configs/`.
- `StepRunContext` holds only transient values for one execution — it is never saved
  into project YAML. Settings you can edit belong in the config dataclasses instead.
- Steps that need a human (quality review, bbox drawing, VAE review, export confirm) ask
  through `context.interaction`, so the same step works from the terminal or the web UI.
- Long loops call `context.cancel_check()` (see `prepare_lora_kit/cancellation.py`) so a
  UI "Cancel" stops the run between images.
- Each step writes a JSON report via `prepare_lora_kit/report.py`.

## Who uses it
- `prepare_lora_kit/invoke/` — the per-step entry points that build `StepRunContext`.
- Tests: `tests/steps/<step>/`.

## Good to know
- Several subfolders contain unused leftovers (e.g. the `s1_*`/`s2_*` subpackages in
  `curate/` and `quality_gate/`); their own guides list them.
- `import_step` is the odd one out: it takes plain arguments instead of a `StepRunContext`.
